summary: 016 S2 (DW-13): added the ribbon entry-point surface NavigationGraph.RibbonEntryPoints (new dedicated collection, chosen over extending startup-roots EntryPoints by unanimous gpt-5-4 + gemini-pro design consensus). For every control onAction and the root onLoad, BuildRibbonEntryPoints resolves the callback name (case-insensitive, VBA semantics) against a procedure-name index of the harvested modules -> Resolved (unique match, ResolvedProcedure = module + declared name), Unresolved (no match, verbatim name retained, never dropped), or Ambiguous (>1 module, no guessed module). Faithful-mechanical: name match only, no signature/visibility interpretation; deterministic source order (onLoad first, then DFS tabs/groups/controls/children, then contextual tab sets). New RibbonEntryPoint record + RibbonCallbackKind/RibbonCallbackResolution enums; harvester-schema.v1.1 RibbonEntryPoint $def (additive, optional, no envelope bump). Nullable-when-no-ribbon => HHC golden byte-level neutral (proven via fresh COM run, not asserted).
